records.method: built-in image_gen; whole-object edit, no procedural dirt overlay, slicing, compositing, or pixel postprocessing
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one complete transparent PNG collectible for a refined high-density 2.5D pixel-art game.
Edit target / strict identity reference: supplied bell-stabilized.png. Supporting palette/quality reference: supplied approved 03_curio_restoration_and_collection.png. The target DESK SERVICE BELL takes priority over the concept sheet's other bell design.
Primary request: re-render exactly this copper hemispherical DESKTOP PUSH BELL in its CLEAN BUT STILL JAMMED state. Keep the complete one-piece object: warm copper half-dome, narrow gold rim, rich purple low round base with worn gold trim, the attached flat round copper push cap and its central vertical stem, the single visible side brass screw. Preserve reference three-quarter angle from slightly above, overall proportions, copper dome's existing fine diagonal scratch and small circular dent, purple enamel wear, lighting from upper left, fine crisp pixel rendering and dense material detail.
Required unrepaired mechanical differences from stabilized reference: the central push cap and rod are visibly STUCK LOW, almost down against the dome collar, leaving only a very short exposed stem compared with the raised reference. The cap stays level and centrally attached: a pressed-down jammed push-button, not a handle, hanging loop or decoration. The visible side brass screw on the purple base remains installed but is obviously loose, slightly angled and raised out from its socket with a narrow dark gap underneath it. Nothing floats or detaches. These two faults are not repaired in this clean state.
Cleaning state: clean dry copper and brass with subtle normal age wear and original scratches; no green oxidation, dust, mud, grime or fibers.
Style: finely detailed high-density pixel art, crisp small pixel clusters, sculpted 2.5D material volume, warm copper and gold highlights, rich purple enamel and restrained mauve shadows; match original polished quality, not coarse blocks or smooth photographic painting.
Composition: square canvas, one complete object centered with about 12% genuinely transparent padding, entire bell visible without cropping. Truly transparent alpha background. No floor, scene, tools, cabinet, lettering, watermark, sparkles, sound marks, separate parts, extra objects, comparison panels, hanging loop, ribbon, star hole or lamp. Output a single complete desk bell.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one complete transparent collectible PNG, FOUND / OXIDIZED state of the same 2.5D pixel-art desktop bell.
Edit target: supplied bell-clean.png, a copper half-dome desktop service bell, purple-and-gold round base, attached flat copper push cap with very short stem stuck low, and a loose raised side screw.
LOCK ALL STRUCTURE: preserve exactly the reference's entire connected bell geometry, silhouette, three-quarter angle, canvas, scale and placement, low jammed cap and short exposed stem, original dome scratch and round dent, purple enamel chips, gold trim and side screw visibly loose/raised at exactly the same angle. Do not repair, raise the cap, tighten the screw, remove, detach, explode or redesign any part. It remains a DESKTOP PUSH BELL, never a hanging bell.
Change only physically plausible surface oxidation and accumulated age dirt: add visible irregular turquoise-green and dark olive copper verdigris at lower dome edges, in the dome's scratch/dent, in seams around the rim, stem collar, and loose screw socket. Use naturally patchy corrosion with some thin streaks and granular islands that follow the curved copper surfaces and preserve their underlying illumination. Add subtle dark oxidized tarnish between green patches. Keep substantial readable copper highlights so the same copper bell is clearly recognizable. A little recessed dusty grime near the base is acceptable. Oxidation is integrated into the material, not uniform green paint or a generic mud overlay.
Style: keep the target's fine high-density pixel art, crisp small pixel clusters, sculpted 2.5D volume and detailed warm copper, purple, gold materials under the same warm upper-left lighting.
Composition: one full coherent bell on truly transparent alpha background, same framing and transparent margins. No floor, cabinet, scene, tools, captions, lettering, watermark, sparkles, sound marks, hanging loop, ribbon, separate components or extra objects. Output one complete found-state bell, not corrosion layers, a split sheet or comparison image.
